title: WriteFreely edit_token compared without constant-time equality
description: writefreely_api.rs:108,115. The edit token comparison uses plain == (provided == stored at line 108, and article.edit_token.as_deref() \!= Some(provided) at line 115). This is a timing side-channel that could leak the edit token byte-by-byte. Edit tokens are not high-security credentials (they're for anonymous editing), but if they're ever used as auth-equivalent, this should use constant-time comparison.
